LiveStatus LiveStatus Live Status Alerts Displays ongoing alerts for Discord and Teams calls, timers, study and workout durations, rides, transit fares, food deliveries, and activity tracking. Notification Access Disclosure LiveStatus reads background notifications (such as media playback, calls, audio recordings, timers, fitness tracking, navigation, rides, and food deliveries) including locations, vehicle license plates, or PIN codes, to generate Live Update pills on your device.\n\nAll data is processed strictly on-device and is never uploaded, sold, or shared. Aside from temporary transit data (retained for up to 24 hours), notification content is never permanently stored. You can revoke notification access in system settings at any time. Debug builds temporarily buffer the last 30 supported notifications in process memory for rule calibration; this data clears when the app exits and is never written to disk or logs. Agree & Go to Settings Not Now Media Playback Live Updates Silently displays the currently playing media when the source media notification is not promoted to a Live Update. Discord Voice Call Live Updates Silently displays connection status and recipient/channel name during Discord private calls or voice server channels. Microsoft Teams Call Live Updates Silently displays call duration, caller name, and available actions during active Teams meetings. Show Home Intro Hide Home Intro Home intro collapsed Home intro expanded Once setup is complete, the app converts media playback, Discord and Teams calls, timers, workouts, rides, and delivery statuses into Live Updates. Xiaomi HyperOS Background & Capsule Settings To prevent background notification listening from being killed, check the following: Settings → Apps → Permissions → Background Autostart, and enable this app. Lock this app in the Security App switcher to prevent it from closing when clearing recent apps. If notifications show but the status pill/capsule does not, allow floating or focus notifications. Menu labels may vary by HyperOS version and region; the button below opens system settings.
